primary.summary: Cross-sectional funding-rate carry: short the coins the levered crowd pays to be long, long the coins where shorts pay, ranked by trailing funding.
primary.mechanism: Perp funding is the market-clearing price of leveraged positioning imbalance: coins where inelastic retail leverage demand pays richly to stay long are crowded and overpriced, while negative-funding names pay the uncrowded side to exist. Ranking the top-40 by trailing funding and holding a balanced short-the-payers / long-the-payees book collects the funding stream natively (the tournament metric charges funding P&L directly) and adds the price P&L of crowded books mean-reverting when they unwind. The premium persists because arbitrage capital that would compress Binance perp funding is balance-sheet and mandate constrained, and the signal is sticky (funding autocorrelates over days-to-weeks), keeping turnover low at 8h cadence.
primary.falsifier: Net IS Sharpe <= 0 at 1x costs across the pre-registered funding-lookback plateau (neither the collected funding stream nor the unwind price P&L survives costs, or the edge exists only in a single regime tag) kills the family.

backups.summary: Cross-sectional momentum on the return component orthogonal to BTC/market beta: ride alt-specific narrative rotation, market factor stripped out.
backups.mechanism: Retail attention herds sequentially into themes (DeFi, L1s, memes, AI), producing multi-week reflexive persistence in individual alts that is masked by the common BTC factor which dominates raw returns. Regressing out rolling BTC/market beta isolates this rotation component; momentum on the residual captures alt-specific persistence without the regime-driven common swings that cause classic momentum crashes at market turning points. The resulting book is naturally long/short balanced, so the engine's 0.25 net cap does not crush it the way it crushes unanimous-direction trend books.
backups.falsifier: A long-top / short-bottom residual-momentum book with net IS Sharpe <= 0 at 1x costs across the pre-registered lookback plateau, or edge concentrated entirely in one regime tag, kills the family.

backups.summary: Fade open-interest build-ups against stagnant or diverging price: leverage accumulating without resolution precedes liquidation-cascade unwinds.
backups.mechanism: When open interest rises sharply while price stagnates, leverage is stacking up without conviction being resolved, leaving a dense band of liquidation triggers; mechanical liquidation engines then convert small adverse moves into forced-flow cascades whose price impact is predictable in direction. Positioning against the crowded side (fading the OI build) harvests the cascade/unwind premium, which exists because liquidations are non-discretionary and the crowding is directly observable in the aux oi/oi_value panels while most flow cannot or does not condition on it. NaN-tolerant by design: the signal activates only where OI history exists (post-2020-09, live names).
backups.falsifier: No negative relation in-sample between OI-build-vs-price-stagnation and forward returns (fade book net IS Sharpe <= 0 at 1x costs on the post-2020-09 window across the pre-registered build-window plateau) kills the family.
